'''Webb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was affiliated with [[Andronikos Revel]], a pirate who hid in a private room of the [[Siltshift cantina]] in [[Mos Ila]], and served as his means of contact with outside world.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Webb appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Tatooine.
